nodes.text: "Back." She has got the strap fixed and is now doing something unnecessary to a wheel, in order not to go inside. "Ask the other thing."

"Course you do." She steps back from the cart and makes a flat, disgusted gesture at the whole of it. "Everyone wants in this cart. He wanted in this cart. Go on, then — there's nothing in it now but sacking and the rest of my year."

"Someone did." She says it without any pleasure at all. "I heard the yard door twice and I didn't get up, because I assumed it was the assessment coming back for the wheels." She looks at the house. "Twice. Out and in."
She goes back to the wheel that does not need her.
